findings.message: Section 20 says `pause` must take effect before all durable dispatch accounting, a re-offer's retry draw included. In production that draw is written by `Drain.run` (`await self._draw_retry(journal, ticket)` at drain.py:210, which appends through `caps.py`) before `self._runner.dispatch`. The only production dispatch path the ticket can hook runs the whole verb as one admitted work item: `_locked` in `squatch/__main__.py` passes `verb(runner, captured, git)` to `compose_daemon_dispatch`. A pause gate in `squatch/daemon.py`, `squatch/control.py`, `squatch/mergequeue.py`, or `squatch/__main__.py` therefore cannot stop the drain's next retry draw, so criterion 2 ('prove pause before durable dispatch accounting') cannot be met inside the fence. The drain is also a live lock holder the plan says must consume the control inbox. The fence (and `tests/test_drain*` closure) comes straight from the section 20 Phase 3 compact registry entry for `dispatch-pause-boundary`/`pause-resume-activation`, which leaves out `squatch/drain.py`, so re-authoring the ticket alone cannot fix it.
findings.paved_road: fix the plan, then re-author the ticket
